payload.description_html: Images of five Otodus obliquus teeth in labial view. A, CMM-V-9356, upper right lateral, Paleocene or Lower Eocene unknown formation, Morocco. B, CMM-V-1610A, upper right lateral, Paleocene Aquia Formation, Piscataway Member, Liverpool Point, Maryland, USA. C, CMM-V-18645, lower left lateral, Paleocene or Lower Eocene unknown formation, Morocco. D, CMM-V-1610C, lower left anterior, Paleocene Aquia Formation, Piscataway Member, Liverpool Point, Maryland, USA. E, CMM-V-1610B, lower left anterior, Paleocene Aquia Formation, Piscataway Member, Liverpool Point, Maryland, USA.
